name: Refracting Telescopes
mechanism: Combine aligned objective and viewing optics to collect light and resolve distant angular detail
operating_requirement: Qualified lenses, stable tube and mount, focusing mechanism and observer
consequence: Extend sky observation within aperture, aberration and atmospheric limits

name: Reflecting Telescopes
mechanism: Use a figured reflective primary and aligned secondary optics to form a distant image
operating_requirement: Reflective optical surfaces, shape inspection, alignment and stable mounting
consequence: Collect light without requiring a large transmitting objective while retaining alignment and surface limits

name: Angular Image Calibration
mechanism: Relate instrument image positions to sky angles with distortion and pointing corrections
operating_requirement: Known reference positions, repeated observations and instrument calibration
consequence: Turn recorded images into bounded positional measurements

name: Stellar Parallax Distance
mechanism: Infer stellar distance from repeated apparent displacement across a known observer baseline
operating_requirement: Sufficient angular precision, baseline knowledge and separated observations
consequence: Measure a limited distance range with explicit uncertainty

name: Eclipse Geometry Models
mechanism: Predict occultation geometry by comparing apparent sizes, relative motion and shadow alignment
operating_requirement: Repeated sky observations, calibrated angular estimates and a stated motion model
consequence: Forecast observable eclipses within model limits without requiring modern gravitational theory

name: Variable-Star Distance Models
mechanism: Calibrate relationships between changing brightness and luminosity for a qualified class of variable stars
operating_requirement: Repeated brightness records, extinction estimates and reference distances
consequence: Extend distance inference while retaining population and calibration limits

name: Radio Aperture Synthesis
mechanism: Combine correlated radio measurements from separated apertures to reconstruct angular structure
operating_requirement: Synchronized receivers, known baselines, calibration sources and finite computation
consequence: Resolve selected sky structure while retaining incomplete spatial sampling

name: Coronagraphic Starlight Suppression
mechanism: Suppress a bright source's optical contribution while retaining nearby faint structure
operating_requirement: Qualified masks or optical rejection elements, stable wavefronts and alignment
consequence: Improve contrast near a bright object without guaranteeing a detectable planet

name: Exoplanet Transit Inference
mechanism: Infer candidate orbit and size constraints from repeated stellar dimming with alternative explanations checked
operating_requirement: Stable brightness measurements, sufficient observation time and false-positive review
consequence: Identify conditional planetary evidence without assuming every dip is a planet

name: Asteroseismic Inference
mechanism: Infer stellar interior constraints from measured oscillation modes and physical models
operating_requirement: Long observations, calibrated brightness or velocity measurements and model comparison
consequence: Constrain internal structure without directly observing the stellar interior

name: Launch Vehicle Mass Closure
mechanism: Reconcile payload, propellant, structural mass and trajectory losses against mission performance
operating_requirement: Measured component masses, propulsion performance and bounded trajectory models
consequence: Reject a launch architecture whose required mass or impulse does not close

name: Ascent Load Envelope Models
mechanism: Couple atmospheric, acceleration and vibration loads along a proposed ascent
operating_requirement: Vehicle geometry, structural properties, environment estimates and validation data
consequence: Set a qualified flight envelope without assuming all trajectories are survivable

name: Stage Separation Dynamics
mechanism: Model release forces and relative motion so departing bodies clear each other
operating_requirement: Qualified release mechanisms, geometry, mass properties and separation tests
consequence: Reduce recontact risk while preserving mechanism and timing failures

name: Propellant Slosh Models
mechanism: Model moving liquid mass coupling with vehicle attitude and structural response
operating_requirement: Tank geometry, fluid state, measured motion and model validation
consequence: Bound control disturbances without assuming rigid or fully settled liquid

name: Engine Restart Qualification
mechanism: Demonstrate reliable restart across qualified thermal and propellant inlet states
operating_requirement: Actual engine, ignition resources, propellant conditioning and repeated tests
consequence: Permit a bounded restart envelope while retaining ignition wear and finite attempts

name: Propulsive Booster Return
mechanism: Reserve propellant and control authority for deceleration and powered booster recovery
operating_requirement: A suitable returning stage, usable reserves, navigation and a qualified landing site
consequence: Recover a stage with a payload penalty and possible landing loss

name: Parachute Stage Recovery
mechanism: Decelerate a returning stage with staged drag devices and manage landing or water recovery loads
operating_requirement: Qualified parachutes, attachments, deployment system and actual recovery crews
consequence: Recover suitable hardware while retaining impact, corrosion and retrieval costs

name: Runway-Return Stage Integration
mechanism: Integrate a returning lifting vehicle with approach energy management and ground landing loads
operating_requirement: Qualified aerodynamic surfaces, thermal protection, landing gear and available runway
consequence: Recover a compatible stage without implying vertical recovery or low turnaround cost

name: Recovered Stage Requalification
mechanism: Inspect a recovered stage against flight history and replace or refurbish life-limited parts before release
operating_requirement: Traceable stage history, inspection equipment, spares, labor and acceptance criteria
consequence: Permit repeated use only when measured condition supports it

name: Reusable Launch System Integration
mechanism: Close payload, recovery reserves and turnaround resources for a specified reusable launch architecture
operating_requirement: Qualified stages, launch facility, recovery capacity, paid refurbishment and actual propellant
consequence: Operate repeated launches within measured turnaround and life limits; partial reuse remains possible

name: Deployable Orbital Structures
mechanism: Package structures for launch and deploy them into a stable qualified configuration
operating_requirement: Hinges or extensible elements, release mechanisms, actuation energy and verification
consequence: Increase deployed size while retaining deployment failure and stiffness limits

name: Orbital Module Interface Standards
mechanism: Qualify mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces for replaceable orbital modules
operating_requirement: Compatible couplings, actual tolerances and isolation tests
consequence: Enable compatible module exchange without making all vehicles interoperable

name: Free-Flying Manipulator Dynamics
mechanism: Model reaction motion of a free spacecraft while its manipulator moves or contacts a load
operating_requirement: Measured mass properties, joint sensing and limited attitude-control capacity
consequence: Plan robotic work without treating the spacecraft base as immovable

name: Noncooperative Capture Navigation
mechanism: Estimate target pose and motion without relying on an active cooperative docking beacon
operating_requirement: Observable target geometry, suitable sensors and bounded closing trajectories
consequence: Attempt capture planning while retaining uncertain spin and inaccessible grasp points

name: Orbital Component Exchange
mechanism: Isolate, remove and replace a qualified spacecraft module using controlled handling
operating_requirement: Compatible replacement unit, service vehicle or crew, tools and energy
consequence: Restore a specified service while consuming real spares and servicing capacity

name: Spacecraft Passivation
mechanism: Place stored energy and pressure systems in a qualified low-risk end state
operating_requirement: Controllable valves and circuits, known remaining energy and final-command capability
consequence: Reduce post-mission fragmentation risk without eliminating all debris hazards

name: Orbit Disposal Design
mechanism: Choose an end-of-service trajectory and reserve resources for its execution
operating_requirement: Vehicle capability, observed environment and actual maneuver reserves
consequence: Reduce persistent interference without assuming abandoned objects disappear

name: Electrodynamic Tether Exchange
mechanism: Exchange orbital momentum through a conducting tether interacting with ambient magnetic field and plasma
operating_requirement: Conductive tether, current closure, attitude control and suitable environment
consequence: Change orbital energy with coupled electrical and drag constraints

name: Orbital Transfer Stage Reuse
mechanism: Plan repeated in-space transfers with replenishment, inspection and component-life limits
operating_requirement: A serviceable stage, compatible replenishment or actual replacement motor modules, paid servicing and verified maneuver reserves
consequence: Reuse a transfer stage without requiring atmospheric return or free refueling

name: Formation Flying Control
mechanism: Maintain prescribed relative geometry among separately orbiting vehicles
operating_requirement: Relative measurements, communication where needed and finite maneuver reserves
consequence: Support distributed instruments while retaining drift and collision constraints

name: Capillary Propellant Acquisition
mechanism: Use wetted structures and surface forces to present liquid at an outlet under low acceleration
operating_requirement: Qualified fluid-surface compatibility, clean acquisition structures and bounded flow demand
consequence: Feed liquid without assuming gravity always separates liquid from gas

name: Low-Gravity Propellant Gauging
mechanism: Infer remaining usable liquid from qualified measurements despite uncertain liquid position
operating_requirement: Calibrated sensors, known tank and fluid conditions and estimation margins
consequence: Bound available propellant without assuming a conventional level gauge works

name: Propellant Settling Maneuvers
mechanism: Apply bounded acceleration to collect liquid at a qualified feed location before use
operating_requirement: Actual maneuver capability, propellant reserves and verified inlet conditions
consequence: Condition feed at an impulse and time cost

name: Cryogenic Active Heat Removal
mechanism: Remove incoming tank heat with a powered refrigerator matched to the required temperature
operating_requirement: Qualified cooling machine, electrical power and heat rejection capacity
consequence: Reduce measured boiloff within the installed heat-load envelope

name: Cryogenic Tank Pressure Control
mechanism: Manage vapor pressure through qualified thermal, mixing and venting responses
operating_requirement: Tank pressure sensing, controllable hardware and finite thermal or vent resources
consequence: Maintain tank limits while accounting for vented mass and changing fluid state

name: Orbital Fluid Connector Qualification
mechanism: Demonstrate repeatable sealed fluid connection and disconnection across orbital operating conditions
operating_requirement: Compatible connectors, alignment, leak tests and qualified material seals
consequence: Enable fluid service without assuming docking alone makes a leak-free transfer path

name: Orbital Propellant Transfer
mechanism: Move and account for usable propellant between attached orbital systems under controlled feed conditions
operating_requirement: Actual donor stock, receiving capacity, qualified plumbing and energy
consequence: Refill a compatible system while accounting for residuals and transfer losses

name: Cryogenic Orbital Depot Integration
mechanism: Integrate low-gravity fluid transfer, phase-dependent inventory and thermal support into a maintained cryogenic depot
operating_requirement: Installed storage, actual deliveries, gauging, thermal support and service staff or automation
consequence: Schedule finite deliveries without double-counting reserved or boiled-off propellant

name: Cryogenic Line Chilldown
mechanism: Condition transfer plumbing to the fluid temperature while accounting for vapor generation and thermal stress
operating_requirement: Actual conditioning fluid or cooling capacity, qualified lines and monitored temperatures
consequence: Prepare a usable transfer path at a material, energy and time cost

name: Propellant Transfer Contamination Control
mechanism: Qualify transferred fluid against contamination and compatibility limits before admitting it to a receiving system
operating_requirement: Representative measurement, clean isolation equipment and reject or quarantine capacity
consequence: Prevent incompatible stock from being counted as usable propulsion supply

name: Planetary Entry Aerodynamics
mechanism: Model entry forces and heating for a specified atmosphere and vehicle geometry
operating_requirement: Atmospheric uncertainty, mass properties, thermal limits and validated models
consequence: Adapt entry planning to another environment without assuming Earth-derived margins transfer

name: Terrain-Relative Landing
mechanism: Match onboard observations to a terrain reference and divert within available control authority
operating_requirement: Usable local map, qualified sensors, computation and finite landing reserves
consequence: Improve site-relative accuracy while retaining map mismatch and hazard limits

name: Plume-Regolith Interaction Models
mechanism: Predict erosion, ejecta and surface response under exhaust loading
operating_requirement: Qualified simulants or observations, plume data and uncertain terrain properties
consequence: Plan surface exclusion and protection without assuming dust-free landings

name: Low-Gravity Surface Anchoring
mechanism: Secure equipment against tool reaction forces where weight provides little restraint
operating_requirement: Characterized terrain, actual anchors or restraint equipment and load tests
consequence: Enable bounded excavation or manipulation without treating low weight as firm support

name: Regolith Electrostatic Dust Control
mechanism: Use controlled electrical fields to move qualified charged dust from selected exposed surfaces
operating_requirement: Powered electrodes, qualified surface geometry and environmental measurements
consequence: Reduce specific dust accumulation while retaining abrasive and uncharged contamination

name: Planetary Sample Containment
mechanism: Maintain a defined sample boundary through collection, transport and controlled examination
operating_requirement: Qualified vessels, cleanliness controls, integrity checks and review appropriate to uncertain samples
consequence: Preserve sample evidence and containment without presuming sterility or biological harmlessness

name: Reusable Surface Lander Integration
mechanism: Close repeated surface-to-orbit transport around actual refueling and maintained flight hardware
operating_requirement: Qualified lander, local or delivered propellant, surface support and orbital destination capacity
consequence: Permit repeated transport within reserve and component-life limits

name: Surface Launch Pad Stabilization
mechanism: Prepare a load-bearing surface that limits exhaust erosion under a qualified launch vehicle
operating_requirement: Actual surface preparation, construction equipment and inspected material
consequence: Reduce ejecta around a maintained pad without eliminating plume loads

name: Fission-Electric Space Power
mechanism: Integrate a fission heat source, electric conversion and space heat rejection within mission mass and control limits
operating_requirement: Qualified reactor, fuel, conversion equipment, shielding and radiators
consequence: Supply finite onboard electricity while retaining decay heat, startup and lifetime limits

name: Nuclear-Electric Transfer Integration
mechanism: Close a transfer mission around reactor power, electric thrust, heat rejection and finite reaction mass
operating_requirement: Qualified propulsion system, actual propellant and verified mission mass and power budgets
consequence: Trade low thrust and long maneuver duration for a specified mission capability

name: Solar Sail Navigation
mechanism: Steer a reflective sail to exchange momentum with incident sunlight
operating_requirement: Deployed qualified sail, attitude control and available solar flux
consequence: Change a trajectory with weak flux-dependent acceleration without reaction-mass consumption

name: Beamed-Sail Acceleration
mechanism: Evaluate acceleration of a qualified sail by a remotely powered directed light source
operating_requirement: A real transmitter, tracking, sail thermal margins and full source energy accounting
consequence: Support a conditional probe architecture without assuming arbitrary speed or demonstrated interstellar delivery

name: Deep-Space Clock Navigation
mechanism: Infer motion from one-way timing observations using a characterized onboard time reference
operating_requirement: Stable calibrated clock, known transmitted timing and explicit bias estimates
consequence: Reduce dependence on immediate two-way tracking while retaining accumulated clock uncertainty

name: Space Interferometer Baseline Control
mechanism: Measure and control separated optical paths so distributed space apertures can combine coherently
operating_requirement: Qualified metrology, timing, optical delay control and finite formation reserves
consequence: Enable a bounded distributed instrument without assuming formation geometry alone supplies optical coherence

name: Rotating Habitat Bearing Services
mechanism: Transfer qualified mechanical loads and utilities across rotating and stationary habitat sections
operating_requirement: Actual bearings or contactless support, seals, service interfaces and maintenance access
consequence: Support a specified rotating interface while retaining wear, vibration and isolation needs

name: Momentum-Exchange Tether Capture
mechanism: Model timed payload capture by a rotating tether and replenish the resulting orbital momentum change
operating_requirement: Qualified tensile structure, precise navigation, capture hardware and recovery propulsion or other momentum source
consequence: Evaluate a transfer architecture without free net momentum or assured capture

name: Asteroid Contact Processing
mechanism: Contain, process and collect characterized asteroid material while controlling reaction motion and escaped particles
operating_requirement: A reachable characterized body, attached machinery, real energy and contained material handling
consequence: Produce qualified recovered stock without assuming every asteroid is accessible or profitable
